metadata.title: TumorQuantAI colon cancer CD3, CD8, and CK20 whole-slide image dataset
metadata.description: Restricted research dataset containing 30 pseudonymized Motic MDS whole-slide images from 11 source cases: 10 CD3, 10 CD8, and 10 CK20 slides acquired at 0.261780 micrometres per pixel; nine cases have complete three-marker serial-section sets. Original archives, source filenames, sidecars, label/macro content, identifiers, and private linkage are excluded. DSI0 tissue pixels are preserved byte-for-byte while non-pixel streams receive generic same-size neutral replacements, with structural checks, multi-encoding identifier scans, and controlled visual-review panels. Accompanying English artifacts report TumorQuantAI CK20-guided CD3/CD8 counts, analysed areas, positive-cell densities, descriptive statistics, registration QC, and unavailable cases. These outputs are research proxies, not the clinically validated consensus Immunoscore: pathologist-reviewed tumour-core/invasive-margin regions and the validated external reference distribution were not supplied. Restricted draft access does not establish publication, redistribution, ethics, privacy, or licensing approval.
metadata.access_conditions: Access requests require custodian review of research purpose, data protection, redistribution restrictions, and applicable ethics or institutional approvals.
